item.title: LLK Trading Recalls Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.company: Sold At: Easy Wholesale in San Jose, California in July 2026 for about $10.
item.brand: Sold At: Easy Wholesale in San Jose, California in July 2026 for about $10.
item.summary: This recall involves Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys. The mystery dumpling toys are a translucent red color, containing glitter and water beads. The toys have a cartoon face and are packaged in a tan plastic container shaped like a bamboo steamer. The phrases "SOFT and SQUISHY" and "MOCHI MALRANG" are visible on the front of the removable package labeling. There are no markings on the product, other than the cartoon face.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the mystery dumpling toys immediately and contact LLK Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the squeezy dumpling and its tan plastic container, throw them away, and email a photo of the items in the trash to llktradinginc@gmail.com.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
